name: Kazakhtelecom Kyzylorda IDC
notes: Data Center Map lists Kazakhtelecom Kyzylorda at Ayteke Bi Street 13; KASE's 2010 Kazakhtelecom issuer news said Kyzylorda was among the Kazakhtelecom Internet data centers already operating at that time. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Digital Silk Route SEZ Seaport Aktau data center
developer: DIGITAL SILK ROUTE LLP / AktauCleanEnergy LLP
notes: Official Prime Minister review of Mangystau development lists a future SEZ Seaport Aktau data center project by DIGITAL SILK ROUTE LLP and a related combined-cycle gas turbine by AktauCleanEnergy LLP, initially 80 MW and later phased to 250 MW for the data center's needs. Data center IT capacity not stated.

name: Data Center Valley Ekibastuz first 125 MW facility
notes: Interfax quotes Kazakhstan's Prime Minister saying a 125 MW data center is under construction in Ekibastuz, Pavlodar region, for H1 2027 commissioning; the official Prime Minister source describes Data Center Valley in Ekibastuz with 300 MW available power and phased expansion to 1 GW.

name: Data Center Valley Ekibastuz second 125 MW facility
notes: Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov said a second 125 MW Data Center Valley facility in Ekibastuz is planned for commissioning in 2028.

name: Enegix Ekibastuz grid-powered data center campus
notes: Enegix official site lists its Ekibastuz, Kazakhstan grid-powered data center campus with 150+50 MW, total capacity 200 MW, air cooling, and 15 ha privately owned campus; facility directories split this across Ekibastuz I and II.

name: Kazakhtelecom Pavlodar data center
notes: Data Center Map lists Kazakhtelecom Pavlodar at First of May St 325 and describes it as a Tier III facility in a repurposed five-story telephone exchange. Capacity not disclosed.

name: TTC Transtelecom Ust-Kamenogorsk data center
notes: Datacenters.com lists a TTC Transtelecom carrier-neutral data center in Ust-Kamenogorsk/Oskemen, East Kazakhstan Region. Capacity not disclosed.

name: AKASHI Data Center Astana
notes: Official Akashi site describes a Tier IV Astana facility with 4,224 racks and 100 MW IT capacity across four buildings; site says the first phase is scheduled to launch in 2027 and shows live build/progress telemetry.

name: Kazteleport Ereymentau / Astana data center
notes: DCD reported Kazteleport launched its Astana facility in Ereymentau with up to 100 racks, 366 sqm white space, and 2 MW IT capacity; Data Center Map lists the site as Tier 3 / ISO27001.

name: Kazakhtelecom Astana 1 data center
notes: Data Center Map lists Kazakhtelecom Astana 1 at Abay Ave 26, site code ATC-33. Kazakhtelecom's 2021 annual report says the company had the country's largest network of 25 data centers; facility capacity not disclosed.

name: Kazakhtelecom Astana 2 data center
notes: Data Center Map nearest-facility data identifies Kazakhtelecom Astana 2 at Zhanaydar Zhirentayev St 11; paired with Kazakhtelecom's annual-report evidence that it operates a national data center network. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Government data center in Astana
notes: Interfax quotes Prime Minister Bektenov noting that Kazakhstan currently hosts all government data in a single 6 MW data center in Astana. Operator and facility name not stated in source.

name: Freedom Cloud Alatau Technopark data center
notes: Freedom/Turlov page says construction began in the Alatau special economic zone near Almaty on a 2.5 ha site; the project totals 480 racks, 7.2 MW usable IT capacity, 13 MW total power consumption, and 175 billion tenge investment.

name: Kazteleport Sairam data center
notes: Data Center Map lists Kazteleport Sairam in Almaty as a Tier III facility with 120 racks and 2 MW total power; DCD notes Sairam opened in 2022 and also offers 2 MW.

name: Kazakhtelecom Almaty modular data center
notes: Kazakhtelecom's 2021 annual report says it launched a new modular DPC in Almaty with 168 seats, 180 sqm total area, and 3.3 MW increased capacity; KASE issuer news also identifies Almaty among earlier Kazakhtelecom IDCs.

name: NLS Kazakhstan data center
notes: Datacenters.com lists NLS Kazakhstan LLP's Almaty data center providing colocation, dedicated server, virtual private server, public cloud, private cloud, virtual data center, hosting, and connectivity services. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Kazakhtelecom Shymkent Internet data center
notes: Kazakhtelecom issuer news published by KASE says the Internet Data Center in Shymkent opened on August 10, 2010, offering hosting, colocation, dedicated server, security, administration, and related services. Capacity not disclosed.
